checks.name: reviews_ai_rating_check
checks.definition: CHECK ((((rating >= 1) AND (rating <= 3)) OR ((ai_summary IS NULL) AND (ai_suggested_reply IS NULL) AND (ai_detected_language IS NULL) AND (ai_analyzed_at IS NULL) AND (ai_status IS NULL) AND (ai_error IS NULL))))

checks.name: reviews_ai_token_counts_check
checks.definition: CHECK ((((ai_input_tokens IS NULL) OR (ai_input_tokens >= 0)) AND ((ai_output_tokens IS NULL) OR (ai_output_tokens >= 0)) AND ((ai_reasoning_tokens IS NULL) OR (ai_reasoning_tokens >= 0)) AND ((ai_total_tokens IS NULL) OR (ai_total_tokens >= 0))))

checks.name: reviews_attention_rule
checks.definition: CHECK (((((rating >= 1) AND (rating <= 3)) AND requires_attention AND requires_ai_analysis) OR ((rating = ANY (ARRAY[4, 5])) AND (NOT requires_attention) AND (NOT requires_ai_analysis))))

aiTrigger.body:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.enqueue_review_ai()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  webhook_secret text;
begin
  if new.historical_import
     or new.rating < 1
     or new.rating > 4
     or (new.rating = 4 and length(btrim(coalesce(new.original_text, new.text, ''))) = 0) then
    return new;
  end if;

  select config.secret
  into webhook_secret
  from public.ai_webhook_config as config
  where config.singleton;

  perform net.http_post(
    url := 'https://ihuztjkblywzjdruusdj.supabase.co/functions/v1/analyze-review',
    headers := jsonb_build_object(
      'Content-Type', 'application/json',
      'x-home-reviews-webhook', webhook_secret
    ),
    body := jsonb_build_object('review_id', new.id)
  );

  return new;
end
$function$
aiTrigger.name: reviews_enqueue_ai_after_insert
aiTrigger.definition: CREATE TRIGGER reviews_enqueue_ai_after_insert AFTER INSERT ON public.reviews FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((new.historical_import = false) AND ((new.rating >= 1) AND (new.rating <= 4)) AND (review_usable_text(new.original_text, new.text) IS NOT NULL))) EXECUTE FUNCTION private.enqueue_review_ai()
